overview:

Stuttgart Technical University of Applied Sciences

Founded in 1832, HFT Stuttgart is one of the ten higher education institutions in Stuttgart.

The University has three faculties:

  • Faculty of Architecture and Design
  • Faculty of Civil Engineering, Building Physics and Business Management
  • Faculty of Geomatics, Computer Science and Mathematics

You will have the opportunity to follow a Master of Software Technology.

For travel advice issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on Germany, click here.
administrative:
Application Dossier


Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application.

All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.


Visa

  • For European students, a valid passport/ national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).
  • For non-Europeans students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.
Students in France can use this website:
https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


Insurance

For European Students

The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual.

This card certifies your rights to the Health Insurance in Europe.

To obtain your card:

  • Log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure
  • It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks
  • You can also download it online
For more information:
https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger

For Non-European Students

You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay.

Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.

Ariane Registration (French Citizens Only)

Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country:

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html


Campus Life

The University does not provide accommodation on campus because of limited space.

Accommodation is provided by the Studierendenwerk Stuttgart, based on availability of city residences.

Students must:

  • Complete an online form here
  • Submit their Housing Feedback Form to the International Relations Department

A room in a residence includes:

  • Furniture
  • Internet access
  • Sheets and blankets
  • Cost: 45 €
  • Use of washing machine and tumble dryer with a purchased card
BEWARE: The number of rooms requested by students is higher than the number of rooms available.
We cannot guarantee that you will get a room in a residence.
It can take up to 6 months or more to allocate a room at Studierendenwerk Stuttgart.

A room in a residence in Stuttgart costs between 285 € and 350 €.

Rooms and individual units usually cost more.

In general, a student needs 750 € a month to cover all their expenses.

You will find more information on this page.

courses:
The semester dates are as follows: 01/10/2018 – 30/06/2019

You will take courses at the Geomatics, Computer Science and Mathematics Faculty.

You will find the syllabus here.

You will follow the Master of Software Technology program.

You must validate 30 ECTS credits per semester, i.e. 60 throughout the year.


Course Structure and Expectations

BEWARE! Courses are sometimes very theoretical, as well as the exams.

On this subject, we invite you to look at the testimonials section to view student feedback.

You will have about 15h of lessons per week but an important workload at home as well.

We remind you that attendance is compulsory, and absenteeism may result in expulsion from the university.

The list of courses is given for information only.

It can change from one year to the next.

If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible.


EIP: Any tech4 abroad involves an EIP!

Take advantage of the free slots that you will have to advance them.
cost:
Estimated Monthly Budget

On average, a student will need 750 € a month to cover all their expenses.

  • Rent: approx. 285 to 350 € per month
  • Health Insurance: 80 € per month
  • Transport: 200 € per semester
  • Food: 180 € per month
  • Administrative costs to be paid directly to the partner university:
  • 100 € for the first semester
  • 170 € for the second semester
  • Other expenses (leisure): 150 € per month
